manifest.name: gdn-fp8-mlp-q4k-skip0
manifest.description: FP8 on every recurrent (GDN) projection, as in V3, with the MLP blocks after layer 0 as Q4_K and lm_head stored BF16 so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once from the original weights. Each part has passed the private holdout on its own (V3; the MLP Q4_K maps mlp-q4k-skip-layer0 and gdn-mlp-q4k-skip-layer0), and they fix different errors: FP8 keeps the recurrent state, and with it retrieval and long context, close to BF16, while the Q4_K fit of the MLP has lower output error than the shipped round-to-nearest NVFP4 bytes. MLP layer 0 stays NVFP4, so the batched-prefill path stays on. The Q4_K MLP also returns about 1.1 GiB of the memory FP8 costs, so peak memory sits below V3 and #11.
